repomix.user_provided_header: Categories Page API & Design Integration: Complete bundle for connecting the designed categories management and catalog views to backend APIs. Includes Backoffice React mock implementation (CategoriesMockPage, categories-reference.jsx, categories-reference.css, mock fixtures), Vortix admin navigation shell (FinancialDashboard.jsx, styles.js, App.tsx), API client endpoints, Laravel backend catalog routes, CategoryController, CategoryService, CategoryHierarchy, requests, resources, Category model, database migrations, seeders, feature tests (CategoryCatalogTest, StorefrontCatalogTest), E2E test (vortix-admin.e2e.cjs), Storefront category templates (categories.html), and architectural design specifications (task.txt, dasign.txt, api.md).
